caption: Save for your next Tokyo trip! 🎂Celebrated my solo birthday last year at a hidden gem Tokyo cafe where they serve edible Mount Fuji cakes. . 🗻Thought it was gonna be awkward but it was worth the effort!!  The cakes are delicate and came with a whole collection. Don’t forget to check merchs, even their to-go boxes are well designed too🤌🏻 . 🎀RSVP, but walk-ins are welcome too.
